data.one_liner: Wrap any widget to display a customizable popup menu on tap or long press.
data.what_it_does: Allows wrapping any widget with CustomPopupMenu to trigger a popup menu via tap or long press. Automatically calculates the optimal position of the menu while also supporting manual adjustments.
use_when: You need a custom popup menu triggered by tap or long press.
You want automatic positioning of popup menus based on available screen space.
avoid_when: You need a standard Material popup menu that does not require custom layouts.
strengths: Supports both tap and long press gestures
Auto-calculates menu position with manual adjustment options
weaknesses: No preset styles provided out of the box
